data.name: Orsino
data.gender_notes: Orsino is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian name 'Orso' meaning bear. A name of Italian origin, Orsino is a name of royalty and love. It is also a name of courage and strength. The name Orsino carries the meaning “Little Bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Orsino usually hope their child will grow to embody little bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the inner strength and courage of the bear. It represents the power of love and the gentle nature of the bear.
data.etymology: Orsino belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Bear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Orsino total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אורסינו
in_hebrew.meaning: אורסינו - שורש ער״ס, האור ה׳ הבורא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אורסינו הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית, ומשמעותו 'אור ה׳', 'האור של אלוהים'. השם מורכב מ׳אור׳ ו׳סינו׳, שיכולים להיות קשורים למילה היוונית ׳orsos׳, שפירושה 'גבורה׳ או 'עוצמה׳. השם עשוי להיות קשור גם למושג האור והאור ה׳ בכתבי הקודש.

in_greek.name: Ορσίνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ορσίνο προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Το φως του Θεού' ή 'Φως Θεού'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με τις λέξεις 'ορσός' που σημαίνει 'ορθή' ή 'σωστή' και 'θεός', που αναφέρεται στο Θεό. Το όνομα αυτό μπορεί να συσχετιστεί με την πνευματική σημασία του φωτός ως σύμβολο της αλήθειας και της σωτηρίας.

in_latin.name: Orsino
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Orsino origine Graeco, significat 'Lumen Dei' seu 'Dei Lux'. Etymologia nominis coniungitur cum vocibus 'orsos' quod 'fortitudo' vel 'potentia' significat. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana potest referri ad lucem spiritualem et illuminationem quae a Deo procedit.

in_english.name: Orsino
in_english.long_meaning: The name Orsino originates from Greek roots, signifying 'Divine Light' or 'God's Light'. Etymologically, it is linked to the Greek word 'orsos', meaning 'correct' or 'right', and 'theos', referring to God. In Christian tradition, the name symbolizes spiritual illumination and divine guidance. Historically, it may relate to the biblical concept of light as a symbol of truth, salvation, and God's presence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Orsino holds a rich cultural heritage, notable for its use in the problematic and complex experience of love in the novel "For Your Information" (Imperium in Angris) by Roger Zelazny. Orsino is also the name of the Duke of Forciana in William Shakespeare's play "Twelfth Night," summing up the moniker's regal and romantic significance.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual meaning of the name Orsino is influenced by its root 'Orso,' meaning bear. The bear represents strength, creativity, and self-reflection, symbolizing the life journey of an individual. In the spiritual context, Orsino embodies the idea of embracing challenges and growing from them with courage and compassion. The spiritual significance of the name is a reminder of the importance of being strong in character, compassionate towards self and others, and patient during difficult times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Orsino may represent a noble and resolute Christian, anchored in faith and wisdom, with a deep longing for divine love and compassion. His name evokes the image of a shepherd king, guiding his flock with gentle strength and unwavering devotion.

historical_references.context: Orsino was the eldest son of Ferdinand I of Aragon and Isabella of Castile. He was given the kingdoms of Sicily and Naples to rule.
